title: Each tile's date range: options, updates, independent of other tiles
custom_preconds:
Signed in as owner/admin (storage state)
Exactly one invoiced Work Order for a test-created customer, dated inside the CURRENT calendar month and carrying a dominant fixed labour price (seeded via API); nothing seeded into the previous month
Browser storage holds no `dashboard.expandedTile` key
custom_steps:
1. Confirm each KPI tile and the Sales by Customer tile has its own date-range control offering, in order: Last 12 Months, This Year, Last Year, This Quarter, Last Quarter, This Month, Last Month, This Week, Last Week.
2. Change one tile's range and confirm its headline, sparkline, and (when expanded) its chart and table all update for the new range.
3. Confirm changing one tile's range does not change any other tile's range.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each KPI tile and the Sales by Customer tile has its own date-range control.
  • The date-range control offers, in order: Last 12 Months, This Year, Last Year, This Quarter, Last Quarter, This Month, Last Month, This Week, Last Week.
  • Changing a tile's date range updates that tile's headline value for the new range.
  • Changing a tile's date range redraws that tile's sparkline for the new range.
  • Changing a tile's date range updates that tile's expanded chart and table for the new range.
  • Changing one tile's date range does not change any other tile's date range.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490, story SV-9579 (S7 — Per-Tile Date Ranges); Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section S7; read on 2 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R1: “Each KPI tile and the Sales by Customer tile has its own date-range control.”
  • S7-R2: “The date-range control offers, in this order: Last 12 Months, This Year, Last Year, This Quarter, Last Quarter, This Month, Last Month, This Week, Last Week.”
  • S7-R3: “When the user changes a tile's date range, that tile's headline value updates for the new range.”
  • S7-R4: “When the user changes a tile's date range, that tile's sparkline redraws for the new range.”
  • S7-R5: “When the user changes a tile's date range, that tile's expanded chart and table update for the new range.”
  • S7-R6: “Changing one tile's date range does not change any other tile's date range.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
